faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by District Panchayat Surajpur (Surajpur DP) for filling various contract positions at the Janpad Panchayat level in the state of Chhattisgarh.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 8 vacancies have been announced across multiple posts including Program Officer, Assistant Programmer, and Accountant under advertisement number 539.

faq.question: Q3. When does the online application process start and end?
faq.answer: The online application process starts on 25-09-2026 and applications will be accepted until the closing date of 13-10-2026 through the official portal.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum and maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 years and 35 years of age. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories according to the rules established by the Chhattisgarh government.

faq.question: Q5. What educational qualification is required for Program Officer?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Program Officer position must hold a first-class MBA, BE, MRTM degree, or a Postgraduate degree in Mathematics or Physics.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are needed for the Assistant Programmer post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Assistant Programmer role should possess an MSc in CS/IT/MCA or a BE/BTech degree in Computer Science or Information Technology.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Accountant position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Accountant post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 23350, alongside other standard contractual emoluments.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: No application fee is required for any category, including General, OBC, SC, and ST candidates, making the online application completely free.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection procedure for Surajpur DP recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection is based on a merit list prepared using educational qualifications, performance in a computer practical exam, and experience weightage.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I submit the online application form?
faq.answer: Eligible and interested candidates can submit their online applications by visiting the official website at www.surajpur.gov.in before the deadline.
